question: Which athlete clocked 58.11 seconds to win gold in women’s 400 m hurdles at the 2025 National Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vithya Ramraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian athlete **Vithya Ramraj** secured the **gold medal** in the **women’s 400m hurdles** event at the **2025 National Games**.
 
• She recorded a winning time of **58.11 seconds** to finish first on the podium, demonstrating her continued dominance in the domestic circuit.
 
• The **National Games 2025**, which is the **38th edition** of the prestigious multi-sport event, was hosted by the state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
• **Vithya Ramraj** is known for her versatility, competing in both the **400m sprint** and the **400m hurdles**, and she represents the state of **Tamil Nadu** in national competitions.
 
• Her performance at the **2025 National Games** is a significant milestone as athletes prepare for the upcoming **international athletic season** and qualifying events for global championships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vithya Ramraj:**
 
 
• She rose to national prominence by equalling the **national record** of **55.42 seconds** in the 400m hurdles, a record previously held solely by the legendary **P.T. Usha** since the **1984 Los Angeles Olympics**.
 
• She has been a consistent performer for **India** at the **Asian Games**, winning medals in both individual hurdles and **relay events** (4x400m).
 
 
 
• **Aishwarya Mishra:**
 
 
• She is a specialist **400m runner** from **Maharashtra**. She has represented India in various **Asian Athletics Championships** and is known for her speed in the flat quarter-mile event.
 
 
 
• **Revathi Veeramani:**
 
 
• An Olympian from **Tamil Nadu**, she was part of the **mixed 4x400m relay** team at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**. She primarily competes in the **400m** and **200m** sprints.
 
 
 
• **Anjali Devi:**
 
 
• A prominent **400m sprinter** from **Haryana**, she has won several gold medals at the **Inter-State Athletics Championships** and has been one of the fastest Indian women in the **400m flat** category in recent years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **38th National Games (2025):**
 
 
• The event was organized under the aegis of the **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** and the **Government of Uttarakhand**.
 
• The games featured over **30 sporting disciplines**, held across major cities in Uttarakhand including **Dehradun**, **Haldwani**, and **Rishikesh**.
 
• The **National Games** serve as a platform to identify and groom talent for the **Asian Games**, **Commonwealth Games**, and the **Olympic Games**.
 
 
 
• **400m Hurdles Standards:**
 
 
• In the women's category, the **400m hurdles** involves jumping over **10 hurdles** placed at a height of **30 inches (0.762 meters)** over a full lap of the track.
 
• Success in this event requires a unique combination of **sprinting speed**, **rhythm**, and **hurdling technique**.
